messages:
Maya R: FYI rolling the regional ff `smart-routing-v3` tonight in the 01:00 UTC change window. Plan: regional single-step ramps: 2% -> 20% -> 100%. Regional order EU -> NA -> APAC. Soak: EU 10m, NA 25m, APAC 20m.

Tom H: Are we pinning older route for APAC until APAC hits 20%? last time APAC regressed fast.

Maya R: Yes, pin v2 for APAC until it reaches 20%. For EU/NA we'll unpin at 20% after soak. If metrics breach, rollback to pinned version.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Maya R at 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z. Canary: eu-central-1 (2%). Will report step completions.

Tom H: Telemetry gates: p95 latency, request_error_rate, and token_tail_latency. Auto-throttle: if error_rate > 1.2% OR p95 > baseline * 1.35 for 2 consecutive 5m windows, set region pct to 0 and re-pin to v2.

InfraTeam: Note to ops: exclude internal and canary namespaces from ff cohorts: use `--exclude internal_* --exclude canary_*`.

Maya R: Runbook commands:
```
# start canary EU at 2%
/ff toggle smart-routing-v3 --region eu --pct 2 --exclude internal_* --exclude canary_*
# bump EU to 20%
/ff toggle smart-routing-v3 --region eu --pct 20
# emergency rollback global and pin v2
/ff toggle smart-routing-v3 --pct 0 --pin v2 --reason "auto-rollback or manual"
```

oncall-bot: Alerting configured: page oncall if auto-throttle triggers. Also post to #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.

Tom H: Suggest pacing tweak: NA needs extra soak, change NA to 30m hold at 20% before global.

Maya R: Agreed. EU 10m, NA 30m, APAC 20m. Update noted.

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary EU at 2%. Health check scheduled at +5m.

InfraTeam: Confirmed exclusion flags respected. Will monitor KV cache warmups; if gen tail latency rises after bump, consider manual cache warm.

Tom H: If APAC shows tail issues after 100% for >20m, initiate global rollback and open a postmortem ticket.

Maya R: Release notes for product/support: "smart-routing-v3 phased regional rollout to improve p95 latency. Per-region pins to v2 during initial ramps; rollback plan in place if telemetry thresholds exceeded."

deploy-bot: Canary EU healthy at 5m. No anomalies. Proceed when ready.

(End of thread)
